name: Marine fish-and-chips frontage
observations: Native258 confirms pale-grey marine fascia with Fish/Chips wording at the ends and blue stylised central letter.
Red-brick ground floor divided into several openings by actual brick piers, rather than one continuous glazed shop pane.
Dark-framed display/door openings have pale lintels; central door and window transoms show real rhythm.
Three dark multi-pane upper windows beneath pale lintels and a long shallow pitched roof.
Small wall cameras/boxes and cables occur around sign/brick face.
Parked car masks plinth/threshold; sign/display materials should be separated from brick.
unknowns: Exact dimensions, rear elevation and interior layout are not established. Street View address is a camera label, not this unit address.
review_basis: All listed captures reviewed in contact sheets; selected originals also inspected at native resolution. Notes describe visible appearance, not surveyed construction.
placement_confidence: Approximate frontage marker derived from camera route, side and estimated offset; not a measured footprint.

map_position.method: Estimated offset from photographed camera route; B050 uses Google place pin. Not measured building geometry.
